title: Auditioning for the high-school band as drummer and singer
summary: Greer boasts to his German teacher that he can outplay the school drummer, auditions with a pianist and gets the job; he also talks about singing popular love songs.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: Now, after he left and went to New York after he stayed a week with us as our guest, I went to school and I run into my German teacher. I say, 'Hey, Miss Bruskey, I can beat that guy drumming you got in that band. He ain't nothing.' I say, 'I can't beat him.' Now, I'm her star pupil in German language. She said, 'oh, you're kidding.' Said, 'no, I'm serious.' She said, 'I tell you what you do, you give me an audition.'

I said, 'All you got to do is bring the piano player,' had a good white boy, you know, hell of a piano player, so he come down and in the meantime they had an eight-piece band that played all the basketball games, all the affairs around that school, so she come around -- I dropped this thing on her. I went through the whole repertoire, man, like Peggie just showed me. Her mouth flew open, never closed. She said 'You sing.' I say, 'do I sing. Does a mockingbird,' so I could sing. You know, a young kid, had a nice voice, could sing. In fact, the

majority of colored person could sing, that's our heritage, singing and dancing, that is our heritage. Don't let nobody kid you. Rhythm, singing and dancing is our heritage. At this later date, they still ain't caught it. They imitate it but we're the real McCoy. You better believe it.
So I laid it on her, and I was all up on the popular songs. I laid a couple of them on her too. She said, 'you got the job.'
Do you remember what any of the popular songs were that you did at that time?

Who. "Avalon." (Sings) "I lost my heart in Avalon." I didn't sing nothing but a pretty songs. I was a crooner. I didn't sing no sugary boogy song. I sing heavy love songs. I didn't sing none of that bullshit, that stuff, My man done me wrong and "Daddy Daddy, La La.." I sang heavy love songs. I stayed up on them.
